pages.text: Dark matter streams through at ~230 km/s. A WIMP of mass m_χ hitting a nucleus of mass m_N can give it at most 2µ²v²/m_N of recoil - so match the target to the WIMP. Bolometers resolve ΔE ∝ T^(5/2): light dark matter needs millikelvin.
$(thing)Set$(): Target mass number, Recoil threshold, Detector mass, Shield field.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Neutron background varies by ±30%·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): Threshold above the maximum recoil: nothing can be seen; Threshold inside the thermal noise; Interlock: veto-shield magnet not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the veto-shield magnet quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Collection follows the detection significance.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Nucleus mass: m_N = 0.9315·A$(br)Reduced mass: µ = m_χm_N/(m_χ + m_N)$(br)Maximum recoil: E_max = 2µ²v_max²/m_N$(br)Typical recoil: E₀ = 2µ²v₀²/m_N$(br)Signal events: S ∝ M·A²µ²/m_χ·e^(−E/E₀)$(br)Background: B ∝ M·e^(−E/3 keV)$(br)Energy resolution: ΔE ∝ T^(5/2)
